name: Live computer view
summary: When an agent drives a browser or desktop, the user sees a live view of that screen, can watch, take over to handle logins or tricky steps, and hand control back. Browser infrastructure such as Browserbase exposes an embeddable live view for this.
how: Run the agent's browser or desktop in a sandbox
Stream the screen into the UI, read-only by default
Switch to interactive mode when the user takes over
Return control to the agent and continue the task
facts: Browserbase Live View (embeddable iframe, read-only or read/write)
Transparent and recoverable, but costly to stream and run
goodFor: Logins, CAPTCHAs and credential handoff by a human
watchOut: Mobile keyboards and small screens are awkward
Users may see sensitive data on screen
